raw_proposals.name: MR9_HalsteadVolumeIncrease
raw_proposals.description: Increase Halstead volume (v) by 20% to simulate a more complex module.
raw_proposals.expected_relation: Defect probability must be >= original after volume increase.
raw_proposals.rationale: Higher Halstead volume indicates more complex logic, which should increase defect likelihood.

raw_proposals.name: MR10_HalsteadDifficultyIncrease
raw_proposals.description: Increase Halstead difficulty (d) by 25%, simulating harder-to-understand code.
raw_proposals.expected_relation: Defect probability must be >= original after difficulty increase.
raw_proposals.rationale: Higher difficulty score correlates with more error-prone code.

raw_proposals.name: MR11_OperatorOperandSwap
raw_proposals.description: Swap unique operators (uniq_op) and unique operands (uniq_opnd) columns.
raw_proposals.expected_relation: Output label must remain unchanged after operand/operator swap.
raw_proposals.rationale: Operator and operand counts play symmetrical roles in Halstead complexity.

raw_proposals.name: MR12_BranchCountDoubling
raw_proposals.description: Double branchCount to simulate additional conditional paths.
raw_proposals.expected_relation: Defect probability must be >= original after branch count doubling.
raw_proposals.rationale: More branches increase cyclomatic complexity and defect risk.

raw_proposals.name: MR13_LOCCommentReduction
raw_proposals.description: Halve lOComment to simulate removal of documentation comments.
raw_proposals.expected_relation: Defect probability must be >= original after comment reduction.
raw_proposals.rationale: Fewer comments reduce maintainability and may indicate higher defect density.
